description: Triages one, several or all untriaged tracker issues: type, code area, duplicates and possible security reports, as a report for human review. Once approved, applies `state/*` labels and a plain-language comment for the reporter. A `decisions` run walks through issues waiting on a maintainer. Use to classify a backlog, or one issue before acting on it. Owns the plugin's state labels, its tracker comment format, and its rule for handling security reports.
